hero.zh: 先理解为什么，再选择在哪里。

intro.zh: 滚动负责建立语境；点击负责在空间中检索。两种输入不在同一时刻争夺控制权。
intro.en: Scroll builds context. Click retrieves spatial records. The two inputs never compete for control at the same time.

title.zh: 一座城市把记忆写进公共物。
title.en: A city writes memory into public objects.

body.zh: 第一章建立这些地点为何值得被记录。
body.en: The first act establishes why these places deserve a record.

title.zh: 时间留下不均匀的证据。

body.zh: 档案、磨损和口述历史组成不同强度的线索。
body.en: Archives, wear, and oral histories form evidence of different strength.

body.zh: 下一屏明确把控制权从滚动交给热点选择。
body.en: The next screen explicitly hands control from scrolling to hotspot selection.

note.zh: 公共钟记录港口从风帆转向电力。
note.en: A public clock records the harbour's transition from sail to electricity.

note.zh: 手写记录补上三十七年的气候空白。
note.en: Handwritten records bridge thirty-seven years of missing climate data.

note.zh: 工单让工业技能重新可见。
note.en: Work orders make industrial knowledge visible again.

note.zh: 历史刻度把风暴潮变成可比较证据。
note.en: Historic marks turn storm surge into comparable evidence.
